stateContract.owner: server quest state keyed by player and quest instance
stateContract.projection: finite item variant; not arbitrary numeric text
stateContract.inputOwner: target addon adapter; no handler is included
preconditions: request belongs to the current player, quest instance and revision
current slot still contains the same owned map instance
do not overwrite unrelated items or treat typeId alone as instance identity
update: validate canonical quest state before selecting the item variant
read current equipment immediately before replacement; preserve required item metadata
replace only the approved map instance and check the adapter result
on failure keep canonical state and retry only after revalidation
cleanup: cancel delayed callbacks on unequip, close, death, disconnect or session revision change
do not restore saved equipment blindly after death, respawn, inventory movement or reconnect
reconcile the currently owned map with canonical quest state when the player is available again

runtimeCases: main/offhand and first/third-person, including rapid hand changes
another observer and armor stand: player selector scope must match intent
normal and slim skins, GUI scale and requested mobile/controller profile
use/cancel/close, slot switch during callback, death/rejoin, world/pack reload
inspect alpha corners, both faces, clipping, nearby occlusion and readable state marker
limits: Pose coordinates are authored starting points, not measured device calibration.
No server script, command registration, arbitrary click region or equipment grant is installed.
entity_alphatest availability and shader behavior require target-client evidence.
Opaque/cutout sample has no glint or translucency contract.
